name: How long does the storm flood restoration process typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does the storm flood restoration process typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of storm flood restoration varies widely depending on the severity of the flood, the size of the affected area, and the type of materials damaged. Basic water extraction and drying for minor floods might take 3-5 days. However, extensive damage requiring demolition, mold remediation, and reconstruction can extend the process for several weeks to months. We provide a projected timeline after our initial assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Restoration time varies, from 3-5 days for minor floods to several weeks or months for extensive damage requiring reconstruction.
